title: [29.X]-VAT Settlement G/L Entries Do Not Populate Source Currency Amount and Source VAT Currency Amount After Running Calculate and Post VAT Settlement
summary: The Calc. and Post VAT Settlement report now fills in Source Currency Amount and Source VAT Currency Amount on the VAT settlement G/L entries it posts. This is a 29.x release fix.
key_points: G/L entries posted by Calc. and Post VAT Settlement were missing Source Currency Amount and Source VAT Currency Amount
The report was changed in the AU, BE, ES, IT, NO and W1 layers
Tests were added to the VAT settlement test codeunits in several localizations
